name: Home Energy Emergency Assistance Scheme (HEEAS)
summary: One-off help paying an electricity or gas bill for Queenslanders hit by an emergency or short-term financial crisis.
key: The scheme pays up to $720 once every 2 years.
who: Hold a current concession card, have income at or below the part-age pension maximum, or be on your provider's hardship program or payment plan
Faced an unforeseen emergency or short-term financial crisis in the past 12 months
how: Contact your energy provider to check eligibility and get an application number
catches: Payment goes to your energy provider, not to you.
